module.title: Back of House Procedures and Execution
module.description: Back of house procedures: ingredient verification and hidden risks, safe kitchen execution, and final verification before service.

lessons.title: Ingredient Verification and Hidden Risks
lessons.body_md:
Before preparing an allergy-sensitive meal, ingredients must always be verified.

Staff should never assume a dish is safe based on appearance or past experience.

Hidden allergens may exist in:

- Sauces
- Marinades
- Dressings
- Spice blends
- Packaged ingredients
- Fryer coatings
- Prepared foods

Staff should:

- Check ingredient labels when available
- Confirm ingredients with management when uncertain
- Review sauces and pre-made items carefully
- Stop and verify if unsure

> **Important:**
> Never guess whether an ingredient contains an allergen.
>
> If ingredients cannot be verified, the safest decision may be to avoid serving the dish.

quick_check.question: Why should ingredients always be verified before preparing an allergy-sensitive meal?

options.text: Hidden allergens may exist in sauces, marinades, and prepared foods

lessons.title: Safe Kitchen Execution Procedures
lessons.body_md:
Allergy-sensitive meals should follow structured kitchen procedures designed to reduce cross-contact risk.

Before preparation begins:

- Identify the allergy clearly
- Prepare a clean workspace
- Use clean utensils and tools
- Separate allergen-containing foods when possible

During preparation:

- Keep allergy orders separate from other dishes
- Avoid unnecessary exposure to allergens
- Use clean gloves and wash hands appropriately
- Maintain awareness throughout preparation

High-risk situations include:

- Shared fryers
- Shared grills
- Shared prep surfaces
- Shared utensils

> **Important:**
> Even small mistakes during preparation can create allergen risk.

quick_check.question: What should staff do before preparing an allergy-sensitive meal?

options.text: Prepare a clean workspace and identify the allergy clearly

lessons.title: Final Verification Before Service
lessons.body_md:
Before an allergy-sensitive dish is served, a final verification step should be completed.

Staff should confirm:

- The correct ingredients were used
- Modifications were completed properly
- No allergen-containing garnish or ingredient was added
- The dish matches the allergy request

Staff should also:

- Visually inspect the plate
- Confirm the correct guest will receive the dish
- Communicate clearly with front of house staff when needed

> **Important:**
> The final verification step should never be rushed.
>
> A mistake at the final stage can still expose a guest to allergens.

quick_check.question: What is the purpose of final verification before service?

options.text: Confirm the dish was prepared safely and correctly
